verdict.rationale: RDAP evidence confirms Namecheap's own domain uses 'WITHHELD FOR PRIVACY LLC' as the registrant proxy, showing privacy redaction is active, but there is no documentation confirming it is free-by-default for all customers/TLDs or that no upsell occurs at checkout. Missing for 10: pricing/signup docs confirming free inclusion, independent user confirmation of no upsell flow, and coverage across different TLDs/domains beyond the vendor's own.
